acceptanceCriteria: `corvint help cem ACTION` and `--help` on verify-stable and gate-verdict print that action's usage only and exit 0; tests cover each.
body: Residual from GitHub beamfall/corvint#1335 (PR #1342, V1-2102, CEM-V1-340): `cem ACTION --help` now prints only that action, but `corvint help cem ACTION`, `cem verify-stable --help` and `cem gate-verdict --help` still lack per-action help. Also the cite-span-not-stable guidance names only the nearest unedited span above and below.
